entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Heh, sorry I kinda pressured you into[n]doing this.
entries.uk: Хе, вибач, що я тебе трохи до цього[n]примусив.

entries.speaker: Newscaster
entries.en: And now to our next topic... Fall from[n]Grace: the story of a dishonored Olympic[n]medalist.
entries.uk: А тепер наступна тема... «Падіння[n]з п'єдесталу»: історія зганьбленого[n]олімпійського призера.

entries.speaker: Newscaster
entries.en: Just recently, a high school coach[n]confessed at an assembly that he had[n]been repeatedly abusing students.

entries.speaker: Newscaster
entries.en: Given his prior Olympic achievements,[n]this has caused quite a stir.

entries.speaker: Newscaster
entries.en: What caused this habitual offender to[n]suddenly confess these heinous crimes[n]to his entire school?
entries.uk: Що змусило цього рецидивіста раптом[n]зізнатися в огидних злочинах перед[n]усією школою?

entries.speaker: Newscaster
entries.en: The police are hoping that the upcoming[n]interrogations will bring light to this[n]question.
entries.uk: Поліція сподівається, що майбутні допити[n]проллють світло на це питання.

entries.speaker: Male Student's Voice
entries.en: My friends would come back from[n]practice with bruises all the time...
entries.uk: Мої друзі постійно поверталися з[n]тренувань у синцях...

entries.speaker: Male Student's Voice
entries.en: It was scary, but I'm relieved that the[n]abuse is finally going to end now.
entries.uk: Було страшно, але я радий, що[n]знущанням нарешті настане край.

entries.speaker: Female Student's Voice
entries.en: He would touch me and stuff all the time...
entries.uk: Він постійно мене торкався і все таке...

entries.speaker: Female Student's Voice
entries.en: I'm glad I don't have to deal with that[n]sexual harassment anymore...

entries.speaker: Female Student's Voice
entries.en: There were always rumors, sure. Not many[n]people believed them though.

entries.speaker: Female Student's Voice
entries.en: Like... I'm totally shocked they were[n]actually true. At least now I can go to[n]school without worrying.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: I knew it. This is your school, isn't it?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Things might be getting turbulent at[n]school, but you need to just keep your[n]head down, all right?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
